content:
Hi Guys,

what do you think about Specula (https://github.com/specula-org/Specula)?

Specula coding agents write TLA+ specs, but this potentially could also be Veil, right? Or is this too far fetched? I find the list of bugs found by Specula impressive (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AVXdKjNfD4952hZqyB-_wTdrzeTw0SD73f3F0zWJ0as).

PS: Thanks for your work on Veil!

Hi @Artur Lojewski. Specula is very cool and the list of bugs is indeed impressive!

It's not at all far fetched to do the same with Veil. In fact, we've been doing some small experiments along the same lines internally, but not at the same scale as Specula yet.

Stay tuned for more :)
